21. The transaction manager has received a prepared vote from a resource manager at time T if a prepared message from that resource manager was sent at any time less than or equal to T.
22. The transaction manager has received an abort vote from a resource manager at time T if an abort vote message from that resource manager was sent at any time less than or equal to T.
23. If the transaction manager is in the init state at time T and has not crashed at time T, then the transaction manager is in the collecting state at time T plus 1.

If the transaction manager is in the collecting state at time T, has received a prepared vote from rm1 at time T, has received a prepared vote from rm2 at time T, has received a prepared vote from rm3 at time T, and has not crashed at time T, then the transaction manager is in the committed state at time T plus 1.
25. If the transaction manager is in the collecting state at time T, has received an abort vote from any resource manager at time T, and has not crashed at time T, then the transaction manager is in the aborted state at time T plus 1.
26. If the transaction manager is in the committed state at time T plus 1 and was not in the committed state at time T, then a commit message to every resource manager is sent at time T plus 1.
27. If the transaction manager is in the aborted state at time T plus 1 and was not in the aborted state at time T, then an abort decision message to every resource manager is sent at time T plus 1.
28. A resource manager has received a commit message at time T if a commit message to that resource manager was sent at time T.
29. A resource manager has received a commit message at time T if it had received a commit message at time T minus 1.
30. A resource manager has received an abort decision message at time T if an abort decision message to that resource manager was sent at time T.
